class: a passage that is not what the witness held

expect.why: the witness resolves — commit 01 holds a section that digests to it — and the prose on the entry is still not what came out of it: one line says three decimal places where the note said two
the repair is to restore the passage from the version the witness names, not to re-anchor the witness to the text that was written: the entry is quoting an artifact, and the artifact said two

note: the class the whole mechanism exists to refuse, and the one a witness alone does not catch. A witness that resolves says the section was there; it does not say the prose on the entry is what was taken out of it. The seed states the end state a careless lift leaves rather than running the command, because a seed is files on disk.
history: apply commits/01, commits/02, … as successive commits in a fresh repository; expectations name the commit they apply to. `@commitNN` in an entry is substituted with the real short object id of that commit before it is made, because a seed cannot know an id the runner has not created yet
